newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt shares hit lowest level for a month.
newsitem.headline: Egypt shares hit lowest level for a month.

text.p: The Egyptian all-share index lost 5.82 points on Sunday to close at its lowest level in a month, the Capital Market Authority (CMA) said in its daily report.

The index closed at 392.72 points, its lowest level since February 3. It was the fourth consecutive day that the market slipped after reaching a record high on February 24 when it closed at 427.77 points.
